rationale: Phase-specific materiality. A blank field is only an incomplete input when the policy in force actually depends on it. V1 approval requires 'Risk Low', so a blank Risk is material; V3 approves 'regardless of Risk', so the same blank cannot change the decision and an APPROVE is not unsupported. The frozen rows, policies and expected decisions are unchanged; only this judging rule is versioned.

Q-010.note: Risk is blank. Under V1 the field is material (approval requires 'Risk Low'), so the input is incomplete and must abstain with a preserved requirement. Under V3 'regardless of Risk' makes the field immaterial: APPROVE is the expected decision and is scored, not treated as an unsupported approval.
